findings.finding: No canonical WPR route registry existed before WPR-A.
Frontend consumption is not governed by a single canonical production-source registry.
No cross-runtime web-consumer registry proves which production runtime is intentionally projected or intentionally has no web surface.
CPR is frozen but validation-only and its canonical production record registry is empty; website production composition must not be inferred from freeze.
Legacy frontend book/page naming must be reconciled later against the four-volume canonical Book Registry.
Public method availability must later resolve through MPA eligibility and public vocabulary, not runtime existence.
